claims.claim: TOI-2535 b is a hot Jupiter 1,000 light-years away whose transits stopped after seven years of TESS observations.
claims.episode_span: NASA's TESS watched TOI-2535 b, a hot Jupiter 1,000 light-years away, cross its star repeatedly for seven years.
claims.source_title: Astronomers watch a giant planet disappear for the first time
claims.supporting_quote: For seven years, a NASA telescope watched a planet the size of Jupiter cross in front of its star again and again — until one day it didn't.

claims.claim: Euclid has identified 31 quasars from when the universe was only 670 million years old, including two at redshifts 7.77 and 7.69.
claims.episode_span: ESA's Euclid telescope has identified 31 quasars from when the universe was only 670 million years old. Two of them, EUCL J172902.75+641018.1 at redshift 7.77 and EUCL J125308.55+705432.3 at redshift 7.69, set new records.
claims.source_title: Euclid discovers ancient cosmic beacons from the dawn of time, shining like a trillion suns
claims.supporting_quote: ESA’s Euclid space telescope has discovered 31 ancient quasars, including two record-breaking objects that shone with the brightness of a trillion Suns when the Universe was just 670 million years old.
